fields.statement: QA: make -n test shows both go tests with -skip of the five-name BUDGET_TESTS regex, no -run of it, no 'Timing budgets' phase or RHIZA_BUDGET_LOG; make -n check likewise (2 skip lines, 0 budget -run); make -n test-budgets runs -count=1 -p 1 -run BUDGET_TESTS over ./internal/api ./internal/index ./internal/slice and prints the timings; go test -list finds every name (TestReadBudget, TestReadBudgetApply, TestDriverPollIsCheap in api, TestBudget and TestCatchUpBudget in index, TestBudget in slice; TestGeneratedModel exists nowhere); test-scripts/test-api/test-rest dry-runs skip the budgets; SHARD=0/2 fails cleanly; ci.yml budgets job runs make test-budgets; make help, AGENTS.md and README.md say make check is what CI runs but make test-budgets; grep 'everything CI runs' Makefile AGENTS.md README.md prints nothing; TestMakeTestTimeout, TestMakeTestShardTargets, TestMakeUpdateDryRun pass; failure case: in a scratch worktree with a budget -run added to make test's recipe, TestMakeTestTimeout fails with 'make -n test runs the timing budgets'.

QA: grep 'time.Sleep(2200' internal/api/*_test.go finds nothing, time.Sleep(2 * pollDebounce) stays (run_model_cache_test.go:220); no internal/index change, racyWindow still 2s, no budget limit in the diff; behind the machine lock (load 3.4) /usr/bin/time go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 1 -run '^(TestReadBudget|TestReadBudgetApply|TestDriverPollIsCheap|TestBackdateLogPassesRacyWindow)$' ./internal/api passes in 67.74 s (under 75 s; TestReadBudget 60.2 s, Apply 3.5 s, DriverPoll 1.7 s); TestBackdateLogPassesRacyWindow passes: LogStamp racy right after a write, not racy after backdateLog.
